overview.description: The Amplify S&P 500 Dividend Drivers ETF (DRVR) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the S&P 500 Dividend Drivers index. The fund tracks a dividend-weighted index of US large-cap companies with consistent historical and forecasted dividend payments. The fund selects 50 securities based on three financial metrics DRVR was launched on Jul 9, 2026 and is issued by Amplify Investments.
